meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会直接通过 OneCLI 网关发送 HTTPS 请求，自动注入已存储的凭证，无需手动处理认证。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取邮件、查看日历、访问 GitHub 仓库、创建 Issue、查询 Stripe 支付或与任何外部服务/API 交互时触发。

say.text: 读取我的 Gmail 收件箱中最近 5 封邮件。
列出我的 GitHub 仓库。
查询最近 5 笔 Stripe 付款记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude makes HTTPS requests directly through the OneCLI gateway, which automatically injects stored credentials, eliminating manual authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with any external service or API.

say_en.text: Read my Gmail inbox for the last 5 emails.
say_en.note: Claude will use the gateway to inject Gmail credentials and fetch emails.
Claude will use the gateway to inject GitHub credentials and list repos.
Claude will use the gateway to inject Stripe credentials and retrieve charges.
